title: Late-Booking Amounts by Packet Received Date before a Performance Trip, Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees
content:
**Late-booking amount (Fine Arts travel fee schedule).** For a Fine Arts Performing Ensemble participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03, a late-booking amount of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees** is added after the shares by the calendar days from the packet's received date, the latest received date among the documents received on the participation's records log, to the first of the ensemble's trips on or after that date: 20.00 when there are fewer than 21 days, 10.00 when there are 21 days or more but fewer than 30 days, and nothing otherwise or when none of the trips falls on or after that date.

Every document received on the participation's records log counts toward the latest received date, whatever its kind. The trips:

| Ensemble | Performance trips of the 2026-27 school year |
|---|---|
| band and orchestra | 2026-10-24, 2026-12-12, 2027-02-26, 2027-04-30 |
| any other ensemble (choir, theatre) | 2026-11-06, 2027-01-29, 2027-03-26, 2027-05-07 |

| Days from the packet's received date to the next trip on or after it | Late-booking amount |
|---|---|
| fewer than 21 (0 to 20) | 20.00 |
| 21 to 29 | 10.00 |
| 30 or more | nothing |
| no trip on or after that date | nothing |

**Boundary cases, choir trip of 2026-11-06 (hypothetical received dates).** Received 2026-10-17: 20 days, 20.00. Received 2026-10-16: 21 days, 10.00. Received 2026-10-08: 29 days, 10.00. Received 2026-10-07: 30 days, nothing.
